correctness.rationale: Defined independent edge-sign Walsh characters and unnormalized XOR convolution precisely. Unweighted Laplacian eigenvalues give tau=m^(n-1)(m+n)^(m-1), which is odd when m odd and n even. In odd n, the signed reduced Laplacian modulo 2 has nullity m-1, proving 2^(m-1) divisibility. The one-leaf signed K_(m+1) cofactor cancels; Schur complements of opposite signed leaf neighborhoods cancel exactly and their determinant prefactors multiply by -d^2, so every odd n has zero modes and the stated distinct-signing lower bound. For m=3, explicit seeds at n=1 and n=2 have determinants -4 and -1, and signed-degree-one paired extensions attain these values at all odd and even orders. The independent Prüfer enumeration/FWHT/Bareiss checks passed 248034 assertions; they are finite corroboration only.

value.rationale: The clique-plus-independent-set graph is a classical, motivated threshold construction. The unknown natural invariant is invertibility of its spanning-tree edge-support convolution. A complete two-parameter invertibility classification, systematic 2-adic spectral obstruction, exponential explicit zero-family and sharp triangular-core gap are nontrivial structural statements with concrete implications for stable Fourier recovery; these cannot be obtained by computing a single small graph or applying parity alone.
